text:
maya: heads up — nightly eval jumped in variance on the summarization promptset this morning, lots of runs failing our ngram-overlap gates :frowning:
alex: saw that. failures are weird — some runs have almost identical seeds but different outputs, looks non-deterministic
maya: exact logs attached in the nightly job — seems correlated with yesterday's runtime PR that swapped RNG implementation in the batching worker (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321)
joanne: can you paste the failing example and the eval diff? we need something we can reproduce locally
maya: one failing sample (shortened):
```
prompt: "Summarize the following discussion about caching decisions."
ref: "Team agreed to move to prefix-caching and monitor throughput."
gold_overlap: 0.76
runA (seed 42): "They decided on prefix caching and will watch throughput."
runB (seed 42): "They will watch throughput and use prefix caching moving forward."
n-gram overlap between runA/runB: 0.52
```
maya: same seed but drop in overlap — that's not expected
sanjay: hmm, could be thread scheduling differences in the new RNG seq across worker shards, or a change in how we mix per-token vs per-request seeds
nick: the PR replaced xorshift128+ with a forked rdrand fallback for GPU-side sampling, intended to speed up batch sampling. might've missed per-thread seeding detail
ops: deploy-bot shows the runtime change rolled to canary yesterday at 02:14 UTC
deploy-bot: runtime-canary deployed to cluster-canary-3 by ci/cd at 2026-03-19T02:14:07Z :rocket:
alex: reproduction steps I used:
```
# run locally with new runtime binary
./runtime --eval-seed=42 --batch-shards=4 --prompt-file=tests/caching_prompts.json --sampling=top-k
```
alex: switching to --force-deterministic-seed (temporary flag) makes outputs stable across runs
maya: so root cause hypothesis: the new RNG change didn't correctly inherit the request-level seed into per-shard generators, causing nondeterministic interleaving when shards differ
joanne: agree. impact: nightly eval gate is flaky for any metric sensitive to sampling order. Need immediate mitigation and follow-ups
sanjay: mitigation options:
- rollback PR immediately (safe fast)
- add gating to nightly eval to compare deterministic-run vs production-run difference and fail fast
- add a canary that runs a 1% production traffic with old RNG semantics for comparison
nick: rollback looks safest short-term. I've prepared a revert PR in draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4330
ops: can revert and redeploy to canary within 30m, want us to proceed?
joanne: yes, revert canary now. also add a blocking gating rule: if seed-stability metric > 0.1 drop in n-gram overlap for seeded runs, mark nightly unstable and stop auto-promote
maya: created a quick eval patch to compute "seed_stability" metric (mean pairwise n-gram overlap across repeated seeded runs). I'll include this in nightly-runner
qa-bot: nightly-runner update queued: include seed_stability check and record per-prompt diffs to S3
alex: follow-ups (post-rollback):
1) add unit tests for per-shard seed propagation
2) make --force-deterministic-seed part of CI nightly for a sampled subset
3) add an integration test that runs identical seed across shards 10x and asserts overlap > 0.9
sanjay: longer term: document RNG contracts (per-request seed -> shard RNG state) and add a runtime lint in CI to catch divergent RNG replacements
joanne: action list — I'll summarize:
- ops: deploy revert PR #4330 to canary now and report canary eval results (due +45m) @ops
- eng-ml: add seed_stability metric to nightly + small canary compare (maya + alex)
- eng-ml: add unit/integration tests for seed propagation (sanjay)
- eng-ml infra: add deterministic-eval mode flag in CI and enable for a 10% sampled run (nick)
- product/QA: hold auto-promote of runtime until seed_stability < 0.05 on canary 24h window (joanne)
ops: starting revert rollout to canary-3 now
ops: revert deployed to cluster-canary-3 at 02:42 UTC
deploy-bot: revert PR merged and canary redeployed by ci/cd at 2026-03-19T02:42:09Z
maya: canary eval running, I'll watch the seed_stability trace. thanks everyone, will post results here in ~30m :thumbsup:
joanne: great. after we confirm, let's open a postmortem doc linking PRs and the new gating rule. also consider a short blurb for release notes about deterministic-eval opt-in
maya: adding short reproduction snippet to the postmortem doc and tests.
alex: +1
